brands.name: ANUA
brands.desc: ANUA built its name on heartleaf (Houttuynia cordata) soothing care and has grown into cleansing oils and targeted brightening serums.
brands.note: Not for sale in the Korean domestic market. No online sales in Russia.
brands.tagline: Heartleaf-powered soothing care for sensitive skin
strengths: Signature heartleaf line for redness-prone, sensitive skin
Pore Control Cleansing Oil: oil cleansing that melts sunscreen and makeup
Actives range: Niacinamide 10% + TXA, PDRN, Retinol, Rice Ceramide

heroes.note: Calming daily toner with 77% heartleaf extract
First-step oil cleanser for pores and blackheads
Brightening serum for dark spots and uneven tone

brands.name: Beauty of Joseon
brands.desc: Beauty of Joseon reinterprets traditional Korean herbal (hanbang) ingredients such as rice, ginseng and green plum in light, modern formulas. Its Relief Sun is one of the best-known K-beauty sunscreens.
brands.tagline: Hanbang-inspired skincare and the Relief Sun range
strengths: Relief Sun range: lightweight SPF50+ daily sunscreens
Hanbang ingredients: rice, ginseng, propolis, green plum
Simple serum lineup at accessible price points

heroes.note: Rich moisturizer with rice and ginseng

brands.name: Braye
brands.desc: BRAYE is a lip-focused makeup brand launched in May 2024 around a 'rough beauty' concept. Its metallic packaging is designed to double as a fashion accessory.
brands.tagline: Effortless 'rough beauty' lip makeup in accessory-style packaging
strengths: Launch product Lipsleek sold out within an hour
In Olive Young online and offline about two months after launch
Layered color + coating tint for lasting color

heroes.note: Staining glow tint, sold out across shades at launch
Blur-finish version of the Thin line

brands.name: CELIMAX
brands.desc: CELIMAX is known for its Noni energy line and the Ji Woo Gae ("eraser") pore and blemish range, plus barrier and retinal lines.
brands.tagline: Noni energy, Ji Woo Gae pore care and barrier skincare
strengths: Noni line: ampoule, toner, cream and pads for skin vitality
Ji Woo Gae line: BHA and baking soda pore and blemish care
Dual Barrier and Vita-A Retinal lines for barrier and firming

heroes.note: Signature noni ampoule for tired, dull skin

heroes.n: Baking Soda Deep Pore Ji Woo Gae Foam Cleansing

brands.name: Centellian24
brands.desc: Centellian24 is the derma-cosmetic brand of Dongkook Pharm, launched in 2015. Its flagship Madeca Cream is built on TECA, a titrated centella asiatica extract.
brands.tagline: Centella derma skincare from a pharmaceutical company
strengths: Backed by Dongkook Pharm R&D
Madeca Cream: over 73 million units sold (as of Mar 2025)
8-variant Madeca Cream range with beauty award wins

heroes.note: TECA anti-aging cream, Cosmo Beauty Award 2024

brands.name: Charde
brands.desc: CHARDE is a functional skincare brand (since 2019) focused on dark-spot, lifting and eye-area care, sold through Musinsa and Olive Young.
brands.tagline: Functional slow-aging care for dark spots and firmness
strengths: Peel-off dark-spot cream mask with 5 clinical tests
Proprietary complexes such as Mela-Melting
Lifthera Gel Mask ranks #1 on its Musinsa brand page

brands.name: crebeau
brands.desc: CreBeau ('Create Beauty') makes placenta- and pearl-based skincare, including multi-piece skincare sets, and exports across Asia.
brands.tagline: Placenta and pearl skincare
strengths: Whitening and anti-wrinkle dual-function cream
Placenta and pearl (conchiolin) extracts
Export experience in China, Indonesia, Thailand and Vietnam

heroes.note: Dual-function cream with peptides and CoQ10
Toner, emulsion, night cream, eye cream, ampoule

brands.name: DONGINBI
brands.desc: DONGINBI is the red ginseng skincare brand of Korea Ginseng Corporation (Jung Kwan Jang). Its Daily Defense line pairs red ginseng actives with barrier care.
brands.tagline: Korean red ginseng skincare from KGC (Jung Kwan Jang)
strengths: Backed by KGC, made with 6-year-grown red ginseng
Capsule ampoule with red ginseng oil and ceramide
Award-winning ampoule: Allure Korea 2023, Singles 2024 Best Ampoule

heroes.note: Red ginseng barrier and firming ampoule
Rich cream with red ginseng hyaluronic acid

brands.name: Dr.Althea
brands.desc: Dr.Althea makes gentle derma skincare: cleansers, toners, pads, serums and SPF. Its 345 Relief Cream is a lightweight gel cream for post-blemish, sensitive skin.
brands.tagline: Gentle derma skincare for sensitive, blemish-prone skin
strengths: 345 Relief Cream: 3 blemish-care, 4 nourishing and 5 soothing ingredients
Gentle amino acid and gel cleansers for daily use
Barrier and repair creams: 147 Barrier, PDRN Reju, Niathione

heroes.note: Lightweight gel cream with niacinamide, panthenol and centella

brands.name: EIOM
brands.desc: EIOM is a derma skincare brand for blemish-prone skin built on skin microbiome balance. Its hero is a full-face patch mask that lifts sebum and debris.
brands.tagline: Microbiome-based blemish care, led by a patch mask
strengths: Bio-cellulose sheet that lifts sebum and dead skin
Patch Mask passed 3.62M units sold (as of Aug 2026)
Olive Young Pick (Jun and Aug 2026), #1 in category on Qoo10 Japan

heroes.note: Full-face patch, you can see what it lifted

brands.name: FRANZ
brands.desc: FRANZ develops patches, trouble care and masks in collaboration with doctors. Supplied to Olive Young, Costco and TJ Maxx.
brands.tagline: Doctor-developed patches, trouble care and ampoules
strengths: Stem cell culture medium ampoules in 10% and 30% strengths
Naked spot and sunshield patch range
Meli-Cica trouble care line and sun pods

heroes.note: Patch that shields the face from sun

brands.name: JENNYHOUSE
brands.desc: Salon hair color and hair care developed by the Jenny House salon in Cheongdam, Seoul.
brands.tagline: Cheongdam salon expertise for home hair care and color
strengths: Salon-developed formulas from Cheongdam, Seoul
At-home hair color: cream and pudding types, wide shade range
Damage care: collagen shampoo, heat-protect oil serum, quick-dry mist

heroes.n: Salon Therapy Damage Care Hair Oil Serum

brands.name: KEYM
brands.desc: KEYM makes bow-shaped lip glows that clip onto bags as keyrings, an 'object beauty' concept popular with Gen Z.
brands.tagline: Bow-shaped lip glow you can wear as a keyring
strengths: Bow-shaped case with a detachable silicone ring
Essence Lip Glow shades with PDRN and peptides
Picked by Harper's Bazaar Korea (May 2026) for cute packaging

heroes.note: Glossy lip in a keyring bow case

brands.name: KITSCH CATCH
brands.desc: KITSCH CATCH makes playful color makeup: single eyeshadows, color balms for lips and cheeks, and colored eyeliners.
brands.tagline: Playful eyeshadows and color balms
strengths: Cheeky Color Balm: soft-matte balm for lips and cheeks
Playful Eyeshadow in matte and glitter finishes
Festive Eye Liner in bold and everyday colors

heroes.note: Single shadows in matte and glitter
Color eyeliners from mild black to soda blue

brands.name: KUNDAL
brands.desc: KUNDAL (est. 2016) pairs botanical ingredients with in-house fragrances across shampoo, body wash and lotion, sold in a wide range of scents.
brands.tagline: Fragrance-led hair and body care with honey & macadamia
strengths: Signature Honey & Macadamia line across hair and body
Scents crafted by in-house perfumers, many fragrance options
pH-balanced, gentle formulas (pH 5.5 body wash)

heroes.note: Moisturizing body wash with 42% aloe, many scents
Mild weakly acidic shampoo with botanical extracts

brands.name: Losy Kim
brands.desc: Losy Kim is a Seoul makeup brand launched in 2025. Its PDRN Tinted Lip Ampoule is a bestseller on Olive Young Global.
brands.tagline: Healthy-glow makeup with skincare ingredients
strengths: Tinted lip ampoule with PDRN, 13-14 shades
Vegan (V-Label) formulas and PCR packaging
Musinsa rating 4.8 with 1,000+ reviews

heroes.note: Skincare-type tint with metal slanted tip

brands.name: Lowlize
brands.desc: Lowlize is a 'clean-clinical' skincare brand launched in October 2025 and sold through Musinsa, with a soothing and moisture-barrier routine.
brands.tagline: Clean, soothing skincare for the moisture barrier
strengths: Soothing, moisture-barrier focused line
Full routine: toner, serum, cream, cleanser, mask, sun serum
High Musinsa ratings: serum 4.8, sun serum 4.9

heroes.note: Light sun serum for sensitive skin

brands.name: medicube
brands.desc: medicube offers derma skincare lines (Zero Pore, PDRN, Collagen, Kojic Acid) and AGE-R home beauty devices.
brands.tagline: Derma skincare lines and AGE-R home beauty devices
strengths: Zero Pore line: AHA/BHA pads, serums and cleansers for pores
PDRN, Collagen and Kojic Acid lines for repair and brightening
AGE-R home beauty devices alongside skincare

heroes.note: AHA/BHA exfoliating pad for pores and sebum

brands.name: MIXSOON
brands.desc: MIXSOON focuses on single-ingredient essences such as Centella, Bean and Bifida. Vegan certified.
brands.tagline: Single-ingredient essences, vegan certified
strengths: Single-ingredient concept: one hero ingredient per essence
Bean Essence: fermented soybean essence with a gentle exfoliating feel
Vegan certified range of essences and toners

heroes.note: Fermented soybean essence for smooth texture

brands.name: percentro
brands.desc: percentro is a sheet-mask brand from a mask-fabric specialist that supplies 250+ brands. Each SKU uses its own premium sheet fabric and shows clinical figures on pack.
brands.tagline: Sheet masks with clinical results on the box
strengths: Clinical result percentages printed on pack
A different premium sheet fabric per SKU
Concern-based range: hydrating, brightening, calming, wrinkle

brands.name: Phytos
brands.desc: Phytos is a bio-pharma-rooted cosmetics company (founded 2010) built around P1P, a platelet-derived ingredient. It runs the Phytopecia scalp-care brand and P1P skincare.
brands.tagline: P1P bio-technology scalp care and skincare
strengths: Hair-loss symptom relief functional shampoo (Korea MFDS reported)
P1P ingredient with micro-emulsion delivery
Scalp care plus P1P skincare ampoules and masks

heroes.note: Mildly acidic functional shampoo with P1P

brands.name: piciberry
brands.desc: piciberry is a makeup brand created by makeup artist Park Sang-eun. Its pastel multi-use pencils work as eyeshadow, aegyo-sal liner, blush or lip liner.
brands.tagline: Multi-use pastel makeup by a makeup artist
strengths: Multi-use pencil for eyes, cheeks and lips
Soft formula that does not crumble
Distinct pastel peach and pink identity

heroes.note: Shadow, blush and lip liner in one pencil

brands.name: TAM BEAUTY
brands.desc: TAM BEAUTY makes jelly-texture lip oils, glosses, tints and cushions with a juicy, glossy finish.
brands.tagline: Jelly-texture lip oils, glosses and cushions
strengths: Jelly Plumping Lip Oil: high-shine, cooling, non-sticky (vegan)
Wide lip tint range in fruit-named shades
Jelly Skin Cushion and Cloud concealer for base makeup

heroes.note: Glossy lip oil with a cooling plumping feel

brands.name: too cool for school
brands.desc: too cool for school is a Seoul makeup brand launched in 2009 with art-inspired, vintage-illustration packaging. Its Artclass By Rodin Shading is a signature three-tone contour palette.
brands.tagline: Art-driven Seoul makeup since 2009
strengths: Three-tone contour that blends or works shade by shade
Retro art packaging that stands out on shelf
Over 11M units sold in Japan (2015-2024)

brands.name: Touch in Sol
brands.desc: Touch in Sol is a base-makeup brand (since 2012). Led by the No Poreblem Primer Prep, it entered Olive Young in 2026 and already sells via Amazon US, Qoo10 and Don Quijote.
brands.tagline: Base makeup led by a pore-blurring primer
strengths: Primer for oily, pore-prone skin with a smooth, non-greasy finish
Layered base routine: primer, foundation, cushion
Existing channels: Amazon US, Qoo10, Don Quijote
